title: Seamless project-local upgrade and adaptive AI contract
summary: An explicit same-major Composer upgrade verifies an isolated candidate before compensating promotion, while capabilities exposes the exact installed AI surface.
invariants: Build and ordinary Docara operations never use the network.
Only an explicitly invoked upgrade may resolve Composer packages.
Automatic upgrade is limited to an exact stable patch or minor target in the current major and project constraint.
Project-owned authoring inputs are hash-bound and never rewritten.
Previous dependencies, engine and verified build are locally restorable before promotion.
The canonical skill discovers actual package capabilities instead of copying product registries.
Federation owns physical skill installation and exact release binding.
